checklist: On the LS-1628u Service Page (Device, Ports and BACnet tabs) confirm the BACnet IP port is 47808 and set the device instance to Autogenerated or Assigned.
Because this is a beta list, check object IDs and names against the unit before mapping, and map by object ID where display names repeat.
Read MV 3 (Occupancy Control Options) and MV 5 (Occ Control Source Status), taking the state text from the unit, to see which occupancy source is active.
Read MV 1 (State), MV 2 (Mode), BV 3 (Unit Enable Status), AV 29 (SAT Status) and AV 21 (OAT Status) and check they make sense.
Write BV 4 (BAS Manual Occ Control) active and confirm BV 8 (Occupancy Status) follows, then set it back and confirm BV 9 (Unoccupancy Status).
Adjust AV 113 (Discharge Cooling SAT SP) or AV 413 (Discharge Heating SAT SP) only if needed and confirm AV 1 (Active SAT SP) follows.
If the BMS supplies OAT, zone or CO2 values, confirm the unit is configured to use them before mapping AV 20, AV 34 or AV 723.
Map BV 27 (Alarm Status), BV 28 (BAS LOST), MV 7 (Alarms) and MV 8 (Faults), and use BV 26 (Alarm Reset) to clear latched alarms.
